data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Tola means ‘dew from God.’ This name appears in the Old Testament as the name of one of the judges of Israel, as well as a descendant of King Saul. Tola was a mighty man of valor and a judge who led Israel for twenty-three years. The name Tola carries the meaning “Dew from God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tola usually hope their child will grow to embody dew from god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Tola belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dew from God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tola total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
